text_verbatim: And with many of these GPT and other really large models, there's this new workload that's accelerating super-duper quickly on -- on large model inference.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Matt Ramsay, TD Cowen, Analyst
text_verbatim: And I think your -- your Grace Hopper Superchip products and others are pretty well aligned for that.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Matt Ramsay, TD Cowen, Analyst
text_verbatim: But could you maybe talk to us about how you're seeing the inference market segment between small model inference and large model inference and how your product portfolio is positioned for that?

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: These large language models are -- are fairly -- are pretty phenomenal.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: What happens is you create these large language models and you create as large as you can, and then you derive from it smaller versions of the model, essentially teach-your-student models.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And -- and so, when you see these smaller -- smaller models, it's very likely the case that they were derived from or distilled from or learned from larger models, and just as you have professors and teachers and students and so on, so forth.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, you start from a very large model and it has to build -- it has a large amount of generality and generalization and -- and what's called zero-shot capability.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, for a lot of applications and questions or skills that you haven't trained it specifically on, these large language models, miraculously, has the capability to perform them.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: These smaller models might have excellent capabilities in a particular skill, but they don't generalize as well.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, they all have their own -- own unique capabilities, but -- but you start from very large models.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

text_verbatim: So, we have a runtime score in the AI enterprise.

text_verbatim: And this is -- this is, if you will, the runtime that just about every company uses for the end-to-end of machine learning, from data processing, the training of any model that you -- that you like to do on any framework you like to do, the inference, and the deployment, the scaling it out into data center, could be a scale-out for a hyperscale data center, could be a scale-out for enterprise data center, for example, on VMware.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

text_verbatim: So, this runtime called NVIDIA AI Enterprise has something like 4,500 software packages, software libraries and has something like 10,000 dependencies among each other.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: The flexibility, the versatility, and the performance of our architecture makes it possible for us to do all the things that I just said, you know, from data processing to training, to inference, for preprocessing of the data before you do the inference, to the post-processing of the data, tokenizing of -- of -- of -- of languages so that you could then train -- train with it.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: The amount of the workflow is much more intense than just training or inference.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: They use it for internal consumption, you know, to develop and train and operate recommender systems or search or data processing engines and whatnot, all the way to training and inference.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And we've been working together for several years now and we're going to bring together -- together, we're going to bring generative AI to the world's enterprises all the way out to the edge.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And then, lastly, because of our scale and velocity, we were -- we were able to sustain this -- this really complex stack of software and hardware and networking and compute and across all of these different usage models and different computing environments.

text_verbatim: And that's the reason why HPE, Dell, and Lenovo, and some 20 other system makers building about 100 different configurations of enterprise servers are going to work with us to take generative AI to the world's enterprise.

text_verbatim: The best way for companies to increase their throughput, improve their energy efficiency, improve their cost efficiency, is to divert their capital budget to accelerated computing and generative AI.

text_verbatim: DGX Cloud's strategy is to -- to achieve several things: number one, to enable a really close partnership between us and the world's CSPs.

speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And the fastest-growing segment, of course, is generative AI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: We're working with all of -- all of the world's AI start-ups.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And -- and so, we -- we built DGX Cloud as a footprint inside the world's leading clouds so that we could simultaneously work with all of our AI partners and help land them in -- easily in one of our cloud partners.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: The second benefit is that it allows our CSPs and ourselves to work really closely together to improve the performance of hyperscale clouds, which is historically designed for multi-tenancy and not designed for high-performance distributed computing like generative AI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY24 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And then, thirdly, of course, Nvidia uses very large infrastructures ourselves, and -- and our self-driving car team, our Nvidia research team, our generative AI team, our language model team.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q1 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

text_verbatim: Now, generative AI, taking a step back about why it is that we went so deeply into it is because it's not just a feature, it's not just the capability.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: Instead of human-engineered algorithms, we now have data.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: We tell the AI, we tell the model, we tell the computer what are the expected answers.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And then for it to figure out what the algorithm is, what's the function.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: It learns a universal -- AI is a bit of a universal function approximator and it learns the function.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, now here we are with generative AI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: It's affecting how every layer of computing is done from CPU to GPU, from human-engineered algorithms to machine-learned algorithms, and the type of applications you could now develop and produce is fundamentally remarkable.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And there are several things that are happening in generative AI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: So, the first thing that's happening is the frontier models are growing in quite substantial scale.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And whenever you double the size of a model, you also have to more than double the size of the data set to go train it.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, the amount of flops necessary in order to create that model goes up quadratically.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, it's not unexpected to see that the next-generation models could take 10, 20, 40 times more compute than last generation.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jensen Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer
text_verbatim: And so, the first one is there are larger frontier models trained on more modalities.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

text_verbatim: And surprisingly, there are more frontier model makers than last year.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY25 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)

text_verbatim: Having already received purchase orders from every major hyperscaler, AI cloud, and system OEM, we expect Vera Rubin to mark the fastest product ramp in NVIDIA's history.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Rising adoption of agentic AI is driving an acceleration in demand for data center CPUs.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Vera completes agentic tasks 1.8x faster on the spec benchmark and provides five times the bandwidth per watt than any other data center CPU.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We expect Vera to be deployed by every major hyperscaler, neocloud, AI lab, and system OEM, with shipments already underway to our lead partners, including OCI, SpaceXAI, and starting this quarter, AWS.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: At Hot Chips earlier this week, we announced that Groq 3 LPX, our first rack-scale LPU system, is in full production and already setting records, demonstrating nearly 4x the number of tokens per second against the next best alternative on our Artificial Analysis benchmark.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Today, we're not just selling the best chips; we're selling a full stack AI factory platform, offering superior economics for customers and capturing a bigger share of the data center TAM.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Our third unique capability is the combination of our full-stack AI factory and rich CUDA ecosystem, allowing us to extend AI into markets a single chip alone can never reach.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Beyond the hyperscalers lies a massive market anxious to adopt AI, customers with no interest in designing their own custom silicon.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: NVIDIA's fully proven full stack platform is uniquely suited to help sovereigns, neoclouds, and enterprises build their AI infrastructure, bring it to full operation, continuously optimize it through CUDA software and connect it to  offtake demand from our vast developer ecosystem.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Our AI-native start-up ecosystem, developed and running primarily on the NVIDIA Compute platform, is scaling at a rapid pace.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Global VC funding in AI, roughly 70% of which is spent on compute, exceeded $400 billion in the first half of 2026, surpassing the $265 billion raised in all of 2025.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Nearly 20 companies, including Cursor, owned by SpaceX, Figma and Together AI now exceed $1 billion in annualized run rate revenue, up from 13 companies in Q4 of last year, with vertical enterprise software logging the fastest growth.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Hudson River Trading and Jane Street are leveraging NVIDIA's powered AI factories to accelerate quantitative trading.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: In sovereign AI, our business, primarily through the regional neoclouds, grew 35% sequentially  and more than tripled year-over-year in Q2.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Firebird in Armenia, Cassava Technologies across Africa, GMI Cloud in Taiwan, Yotta and Neysa in India, Firmus in Australia, YTL AI Cloud in Malaysia, pairing local land, power, and operating expertise with our platform.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Last month, we announced a partnership with Noetra, Japan's national AI company, to build an NVIDIA DSX AI factory that will create open models to power AI agents, digital twins, robotics, and physical AI applications.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: South Korea's LG and Hyundai Motor Group are partnering with NVIDIA to build and scale AI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And in Europe, a record 35 new NVIDIA-powered AI supercomputers were unveiled to advance industry and scientific breakthroughs.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: In this model, we get paid twice, once on the hardware sale and again through the share of rental revenue, a highly reoccurring stream layered on top of a onetime equipment purchase.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Over time, this model can expand our addressable market  and create reoccurring usage-linked revenue stream alongside our core platform revenue, with the potential to drive billions in revenue over the medium to long term.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Together, NVIDIA's three unique capabilities, a platform that runs every model, a full s tack AI factory platform capturing more of the data center TAM, and a CUDA ecosystem that extends AI into markets, no single chip could reach alone, reinforce one another and are the engines of our growth.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Let me update you on our progress with our frontier AI labs.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The frontier AI labs have extraordinary demand for training and inference compute, but they are growing faster than what their balance sheets and credit profiles can support.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: They have rapidly growing customer demand, yet still lack the decades -long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: First, we've invested nearly $50 billion in the frontier AI labs.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: With these partnerships, building on our unique, fungible, and durable computing platform, the AI labs will be able to build and assess AI infrastructure funded by long-term institutional capital at relatively attractive rates.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The initial deployment expected to support 4.25 gigawatts of AI factory capacity will be utilized by OpenAI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately $1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The LPS commitment secures a long-lived AI factory site, while the NVIDIA Compute within the data center can be upgraded repeatedly.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: This project deepe ns our long-standing partnership with OpenAI.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: OpenAI has committed to substantially deployments of NVIDIA AI infrastructure through 2030.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: OpenAI's existing and planned commitments represent approximately 12 gigawatts of NVIDIA Compute.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: For another frontier AI lab, we will provide selective credit enhancement for nearly 2 gigawatts of compute.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: For context, we expect demand from the AI labs for which we expect to leverage our balance sheet to contribute toward roughly a quarter of our business next year.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: In Q2, we shipped less than 1% of our total data center revenue in Hopper 200 products to customers based in China in accordance with the US government licenses.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Current Hopper shipments are dilutive to corporate gross margins.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: On our balance sheet, inventory increased to $32 billion as we prepared for the Vera Rubin launch.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We expect sequential growth to be driven primarily by ACIE with data center, while growth in hyperscale is expected to reaccelerate in Q4 and into fiscal year 2028 as supply of Vera Rubin grows over time.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We see Vera Rubin accounting for about 20% of data center revenue in Q3.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Memory scarcity today is being driven in large part by the AI buildout itself, and unlike a component that simply raises our cost with no offset benefit, tighter memory supply is a symptom of the same demand surge that's driving our own growth.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Colette M. Kress, Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: For the full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low-50s, driven by a broadening of our product portfolio and further increase in the usage of AI tools, which has already and will continue to enhance engineering productivity.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: As you probably are aware, AI has become useful.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And the AI agents that are being adopted everywhere use an enormous amount of compute.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And these agents go through reasoning and planning, multiple turns of tool use.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The amount of compute necessary for an agent versus a human using it is probably 15 to 100 times, depending on the type of problem you're trying to solve.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: I mean, we're the only company in the world that creates and builds, offers an entire AI factory platform, a full-stack system.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: There's sovereign AI, there're regional AIs, there're neoclouds, there're AI start -ups, there're enterprises, where we're seeing – which represents about half of our business, and that's growing 100% a year.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: All of the rest of the supply chain necessary to align the construction, the power, the cooling, all of the labor that's necessary, and with AI infrastructure is creating so many jobs all over the United States and all around the world, it just takes a lot more planning.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: CJ Muse, Analyst, Cantor Fitzgerald & Co.
text_verbatim: There's tremendous investor focus on your inferenc e market share.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: CJ Muse, Analyst, Cantor Fitzgerald & Co.
text_verbatim: Can you speak to the evolving workloads you're seeing with agentic AI and how you see your share evolving here over time, particularly when you reflect on the growing value of the TAM you're seeing with each new full-stack generation, your expectation for greater growth from ACIE, and then also including Groq 3 LPX?

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The AI life cycle is getting way more complex than it used to be.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: There's the first phase, which is preparing all of the data that you need, some of it is synthetic, some of it is real, some of it is human labeled and generated, pretrain the models, and then there's post-training, the third phase, and then there's the agentic inference.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And agentic inference is extremely complicated.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The thing that's really great about the NVIDIA architecture, and we created this with NVLink -72, it was a big surprise on the world when we first created the world's first rack-scale architecture.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We're now in our third generation of NVLink -72 rack-scale systems.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: But what it allowed us to do was to create one fungible system that allows us to transition from data creation, data preparation, the pretraining, the post -training to agentic inference.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And the reason for that is because you've just spent, and we just mentioned, each gigawatt of technology and NVIDIA's revenue exposure in the Hopper timeframe with Hopper plus InfiniBand, and now Vera Rubin and CPU and three types of different networking, because it takes that many types of networking to address the entire world's data center, not to mention the scale -in security networking and the scale-across multicampus networking, so you could argue five different types of networking systems , and then of course, Groq, and all of that increased our revenue contribution or revenue opportunity per gigawatt to $40 billion.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And to the extent that you could use it across multiple phases of the AI life cycle, run every single type of model you can imagine running on it, whether it's diffusion or autoregressive or state-space or some hybrid version of that, every version of attention mechanism you can think of, small or large models, the investment that you make will be preserved and useful and productive for a lot longer time.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We achieved a record token interactivity rate, extremely low-latency performance generation.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: We spent the last several months fusing the NVLink architecture, which will be the core and – it'll be the core engine, and then for services that would like to have super high interactivity, super high-speed token generation done, the throughput is going to be a lot lower, the cost per token will be higher, but you could associate it with high ASP ser vices.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: But the vast majority of the world's data centers will just be Vera Rubin NVLink-72.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: The other half of the picture is what we call ACIE, and that's all the enterprise, the neoclouds, the sovereign AIs, that part of the world is invisible to everybody.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: But the other part of it is, and it's the reason why we mapped it out for you, in the case of Hopper, we were at about $18 billion per gigawatt.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: For Grace Blackwell, we're at about $25 billion per gigawatt.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: And for Vera Rubin, it's about $40 billion per gigawatt.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Meanwhile, because NVIDIA's compute is so productive, the tokens they're generating, the GPU hours they're renting out is insanely profitable, as you know, their margins are fantastic.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: It's not based on retrieval of files, but it's now generative, generating intelligence, and that requires compute.

fiscal_or_calendar_label: FY27 Q2 (fiscal; FY ends last Sunday of January)
speaker: Jen Hsun Huang, Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer & Director, NVIDIA Corp.
text_verbatim: Everybody wants to be part of the AI revolution, everybody will have to be part of this computing shift, and everybody has to build infrastructure.
